item.title: Rallying Cry – June 7, 2026
item.description: Today’s good news includes M&S offering 1,000 young people a fresh start with new traineeships, Pope Leo inspiring youth to lead change, and England celebrating a thrilling Test win at Lord’s—plus a Melbourne kung fu champion and a medical pioneer getting well-deserved honors.
